title: Intrinsic finite direct-image compositor conjugacy
statement: Fix the finite coefficient datum P of [def-pur-conventions]. For any schemes X,Y,Z and composable maps f:X→Y, g:Y→Z use the ordinary intrinsic unbounded operations, normalized adjunction adj, pullback compositor comp, realization equivalences and transported K-injective compositor kappa constructed in [def-pur-finite-proper-product-maps]. Then kappa(f,g) inverse is exactly the adjunction conjugate of comp(f,g).hom from the composite adjunction adj(g).comp(adj(f)) to adj(f≫g). This is an equality of natural transformations, with no properness or boundedness assumption.

proof.text: Use the section-normalized intrinsic realization/direct-image comparisons of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Both intrinsic adjunctions are transported from the same ordinary fixed-scalar adjunctions. Their derived unit/counit equations give the same conjugate after deriving the exact realization equivalences. Expand pushModel and iteratedPushModel; cancel the middle realization units/counits by the triangle identities. What remains is precisely kappa.inv = conjugate(comp.hom), for the specified intrinsic comp.
